description:
## What

Running `cargo test -p pkix-path --no-default-features` fails to compile
the integration test crates (pkits_4_5, pkits_4_6_4_7, anchor_nc,
pkits_policy, …) because they unconditionally import `DefaultVerifier`,
which is only re-exported when at least one algorithm feature is on
(`rsa` or `p256`).

## Reproduce

```
cargo test -p pkix-path --no-default-features
```

Errors with:

```
error[E0432]: unresolved import `pkix_path::DefaultVerifier`
```

across multiple integration tests.

## Notes

- This is **pre-existing**, not caused by PKIX-0x9z. Confirmed by
  `git stash` + retry on prior HEAD.
- The library and lib tests compile cleanly under `--no-default-features`
  (`cargo test -p pkix-path --no-default-features --lib` is green).
- Likely fix: gate the integration tests behind `#[cfg(any(feature = "rsa",
  feature = "p256"))]` or add a `DefaultVerifier` stub for the no-default
  build. Out of scope for PKIX-0x9z.

## Out of scope for current bead

Surfaced while validating PKIX-0x9z. Left untouched to honour the
"strictly in scope" rule.
title: pkix-path: integration tests require default features (RSA/p256) — --no-default-features compile fails
